sentences.en: We exchanged phone numbers at the end of the gathering.
sentences.zh: 聚会结束时我们交换了联系方式。

sentences.en: A big crowd gathered at the scene of the fire.
sentences.zh: 大火现场聚集了一群人。

sentences.en: The gathering will be large if the weather is good.
sentences.zh: 天气好时，参加的人会很多。
